The Mainline Interval is the mean and the sample standard deviation of the time between commits, by author date, then the number of gaps in brackets, as in 2 h ± 1 h (3). It counts the commits that deployments of the last 30 days shipped, each commit once, so it is an interval between deployed commits. A dash is fewer than two commits, or, for the deviation, fewer than two gaps.
